text: Emma is 10. She has absence seizures, they look like staring spells for 10-20 seconds and she won't respond. No treatment needed, just note the time and tell me at pickup. She does NOT need 911 for those, only if she falls and gets hurt or it's a full convulsive seizure (that has never happened). For water games at VBS an adult has to be within arm's reach of her. She's also scared of bathrooms with automatic flush and may ask you to stand by the door.
